entities.summary:
Cao Ang (b. 177 CE) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Classical era, an age of empires, philosophical inquiry, and foundational civilizations, active in Global. 



Known in the fields of military leaders & commanders.



Cao Ang played a key role in the governance of the Eastern Han dynasty, implementing policies that promoted economic growth and social stability. He was instrumental in the development of the Silk Road, a network of trade routes that connected China to Central Asia and the Mediterranean. Cao Ang's military campaigns expanded the empire's borders, securing key territories and resources.



His legacy extends beyond his own time, influencing the development of Chinese governance and diplomacy for centuries to come.



In the words of the Chinese historian Sima Qian, 'Cao Ang was a man of great virtue and integrity, whose policies brought prosperity and peace to the empire.'
